Title: Public Preview: Azure App Service Migration Assistant - Java Tomcat Support

Body.Content:
The Azure App Service Migration Assistant tool continues to expand its support for additional programming languages; support for Java is now in public preview. This means Java apps running on Tomcat web servers on Windows or Linux can now be discovered, assessed, and migrated to Azure App Service. The Migration Assistant tool performs a detailed assessment and walks customers through the migration process.

Learn More
